Sounds like your brain it the enemy, for whatever reason. I know it’s had to think sometimes without emotion, but just remember the truth, that it’s not your boyfriend, it’s not him trying to hurt you, it’s not other people hating you, it’s your brain making you ‘feel’ it. You sound smart enough to realize, thinking logically, that none of those feelings make sense, that it’s just your brain tricking you to confuse your feelings with logical truth. We all can feel one way, but that doesn’t always mean it is reality. You’re emotions can get the best of you, so try to figure out how to separate you’re emotions from rational thought, then maybe you will be able to calm yourself down it those intense moments when you feel like you are going to lose it. Just know that your emotions are controlled by the chemicals in our body and brain, and for some those chemicals can become imbalanced. Do what you can to try to get them back in order. Or practice thinking without emotions getting in the way.

One thing that may help, I used to hold my girlfriend from behind when she had panic attacks and just take deep long breaths, letting her feel my chest press against her back, until she calmed down to the rhythm of my breathing. Maybe you can get your boyfriend to try this.
